name: Barometer and altitude
plain: Reads air pressure; iOS needs Motion and Fitness permission for relative altitude.
meaning: Pressure reveals floor in a building and weather; combined with time it can aid location inference.

ios.api_surface: Relative altitude in meters, pressure in kPa; needs Motion and Fitness

limits.headline: Can measure air pressure and height change, after a Motion prompt on iPhone
limits.user_action: Nothing on Android. On iPhone you tap Allow for Motion and Fitness
can: Measure air pressure in hectopascals (Android) or kilopascals (iPhone)
Track relative altitude change, such as climbing stairs, on iPhone
Help estimate floors or weather trends
cannot: See your exact altitude above sea level without extra data
Use the sensor on iPhone without Motion and Fitness permission
limits.differs: Android gives pressure with no prompt. iPhone gives relative altitude and needs Motion and Fitness.

story.what_it_is: An app can read air pressure, which shows weather changes and which floor you are on.

marketing.name: Pressure sensor
marketing.pitch: Android lets apps read air pressure to track weather and altitude.

marketing.name: Altimeter
marketing.pitch: Apple's altimeter gives relative height changes from the barometer, like floors climbed.

story.for_you: You do not see it. Fitness apps may show floors climbed, and emergency calls can use it to tell which floor you are on. It also reveals weather changes and moving up and down in a building.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to count flights of stairs, improve indoor location and give weather clues. It can also help narrow down location when combined with time and other signals.

use_cases.example: A step counter adds floors climbed when you take the stairs.
An indoor map app finds which floor of a mall you are on.
A hiking app tracks elevation gain on a trail.
A weather app uses pressure from many phones to improve local forecasts.
An outdoor game notices that you climbed a hill and gives a reward for the real world climb.
An emergency location system reads pressure to tell dispatchers which floor to send help.

story.android_note: Android reads the pressure sensor with no prompt on phones that have one.
story.ios_note: iPhone relative altitude needs Motion and Fitness permission.

technical_bounds: Present on most phones, not all
